JUSTOLED.SECTION_CONNECTION_DOC: How the OLED is wired and which panel it is. Detect reads the I2C bus and pre-fills what it can; the panel is yours to choose, and Test display proves the choice.
JUSTOLED.BUS_DOC: I2C: four wires, SDA and SCL. SPI: seven wires, with data/command and reset lines on two GPIOs.
JUSTOLED.PANEL_DOC: The controller and the pixel size, as printed on the module or its page. Every entry the daemon drives is listed; the wiki's Displays page says which are verified on a module and which are described from the data sheet.
JUSTOLED.I2C_BUS_DOC: The N of /dev/i2c-N. Bus 1 is the Raspberry Pi's header bus on GPIO 2 and 3 (pins 3 and 5).
JUSTOLED.I2C_ADDRESS_DOC: Automatic tries 0x3C then 0x3D. Most modules sit at 0x3C; a solder pad or jumper on the module moves it to 0x3D.
JUSTOLED.SPI_BUS_DOC: The B of /dev/spidevB.C. Bus 0 is the header SPI on GPIO 10 (MOSI, pin 19) and GPIO 11 (SCLK, pin 23).
JUSTOLED.SPI_CS_DOC: The C of /dev/spidevB.C: 0 for CE0 (GPIO 8, pin 24), 1 for CE1 (GPIO 7, pin 26).
JUSTOLED.GPIO_DC_DOC: BCM number of the GPIO wired to the module's DC (D/C) pin. 25 (pin 22) follows the Waveshare wiring pages.
JUSTOLED.GPIO_RESET_DOC: BCM number of the GPIO wired to the module's RST (RES) pin. 27 (pin 13) follows the Waveshare wiring pages.
JUSTOLED.ROTATE_DOC: Turn the picture when the module is mounted upside down.
JUSTOLED.DETECT_DOC: Read the I2C bus and say what answers. SPI panels cannot be read; choose them by hand.
JUSTOLED.TEST_DOC: Draw a test pattern for a few seconds: a frame, the corners, the panel's name.
JUSTOLED.DETECTED_NOTHING: Nothing answers on bus {{bus}}. Check the wiring, VCC and GND, and that I2C is enabled.
JUSTOLED.DETECT_FAILED: The bus could not be read: {{error}}
JUSTOLED.TEST_SENT: The test pattern is on the display.
JUSTOLED.TEST_FAILED: The display daemon did not answer: {{error}}
JUSTOLED.SECTION_MESSAGES_DOC: What the display says as the player boots, stands ready, pauses, restarts and shuts down. Two lines, separated by |.
JUSTOLED.SHOW_LIFECYCLE_DOC: The display speaks from power-on, before Volumio is up, and says goodbye before power goes.
JUSTOLED.SAVED: Saved. The display follows the new settings.
JUSTOLED.SAVED_RESTART: Saved. A restart is needed for the bus change to take effect.
JUSTOLED.SAVE_FAILED: Saved to the plugin, but the system could not be updated: {{error}}
JUSTOLED.SERVICE_FAILED: The display service could not be started: {{error}}
JUSTOLED.RESTART_MSG: Just OLED's audio tap joins the player's audio chain when Volumio starts. Restart now so the display can follow the music, or continue and restart later.
